incident_summary: The elevated Phase 4C.2G ReadinessTest fail-closed prior to watchdog creation and prior to disabling any network adapters due to a PowerShell AST parser error in the generated RECOVER_NETWORK.ps1.

canonical_root_cause.parser_error_message: You must provide a value expression following the '-' operator.
canonical_root_cause.mechanism: In Update-RecoveryScriptAndValidate, the recovery script generator constructed an array literal @(...) where string concatenation without parentheses was split across two expressions: a comment string on line 2, and an unquoted raw ISO-8601 timestamp string (2026-10-02T...) on line 3. The PowerShell parser interpreted 2026-10-02... as numeric subtraction expressions containing the '-' operator, failing due to missing operands or invalid syntax. Furthermore, trailing commas in array initializers caused 'Missing expression after ","' errors.
canonical_root_cause.user_action_causality: REJECTED. The termination was NOT caused by the user closing CMD windows. The controller executed fail-closed logic strictly at Step 1 within Update-RecoveryScriptAndValidate prior to watchdog task creation and prior to disabling any network adapter.

generator_remediation: All timestamps in generated recovery script are strictly in comments (#), single-quoted string literals ('...'), or runtime [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o') calls.
Doubled single-quote escaping (' -> '') for adapter names.
Atomic staging: write to .part, flush and fsync, parse AST with [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile.
Atomic rename to destination only when parseErrors.Count == 0 and allowlist passes.
Automated quarantine of invalid generated scripts into failed_recovery_scripts/ with failure verdict BLOCKED_RECOVERY_SCRIPT_SYNTAX_INVALID.
